title: Live Music Bingo with Soda City Serenade
theme: Live Music Bingo with Soda City Serenade
shortDescription: Live music meets Music Bingo at Charter 803, featuring Soda City Serenade and a $100 cash prize in the third blackout round.
description:
Four Dogs Entertainment is teaming up with Soda City Serenade for a special night of Live Music Bingo at Charter 803 Bar & Grill. Instead of listening to a playlist, you’ll hear songs performed live while following along on your bingo card. No musical talent required.

Three rounds are planned: Christmas music, greatest hits, and a 25-song Four Dogs Sound Check. The winner of the third blackout round takes home a $100 cash prize.
imageAlt: Friends posing together at a Four Dogs Music Bingo night at Charter 803
